claim: In September 2026 to date, gas prices have averaged 189p per therm, reaching their highest level since the global energy crisis in 2022, as shown in the figure below.
label: UNVERIFIED
annotatorNote: No September average was found in sources of the article's date. Trading Economics, 1 Sep 2026: 'UK Gas increased to 179.26 GBp/thm', 'the highest since March 2026' - so daily prices were higher in March, which a monthly average of 189p might still exceed; 'highest since 2022' cannot be checked without the monthly series.
